description:
Diagnose "database is locked" / SQLITE_BUSY and writer-starvation problems — the most common SQLite production failure. Inspects journal mode, busy_timeout, locking mode, and WAL bloat for local files, and returns provider-specific guidance for D1 and Turso. Each finding includes the exact PRAGMA or DSN change to apply. Returns a JSON report with a verdict (ok / attention / critical).

Set live=true (local files only) to instead probe the *current* lock state: whether a writer is holding the lock right now and which processes have the file open. Use this when an app is actively reporting "database is locked". Read-only.

live.description: Probe the live lock state right now instead of static PRAGMA config (local files only)

source.description: Database source: a local file path (./app.db), a Cloudflare D1 DSN (d1://DB_ID when CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN+CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID are set, or d1://TOKEN@ACCOUNT_ID/DB_ID), or a Turso DSN (turso://TOKEN@ORG/DB).

name: litescope_locks

Findings.description: Lock-configuration issues, each with the exact PRAGMA/DSN fix.

Verdict.description: Static diagnosis verdict: ok, attention, or critical.

holders.description: With live=true: processes holding the database file open.

state.description: With live=true: current lock state — free, locked, readable, or error.

title: Diagnose database locks
